messages:
Alex C: Hey payroll — received my end-of-year bonus today but it shows as EUR 1,500 in the statement and USD 1,620.43 on the paystub, with ~30% withholding. Is that expected?
Jamal: I saw the same for my APAC bonus last month. Withholding looked like the supplemental tax bracket, not local income.
Marta (Payroll): Thanks for flagging — can you paste the paystub screenshot or the payline here? Also which country was the bonus paid in (EUR suggests EU, but need country of tax residency).
Alex C: attached screenshot (PMed). Paid to my Belgian bank, residency on payroll is BE. Payline: `Bonus - EUR 1500.00 -> USD 1620.43 gross; Tax withheld USD 486.13`
Priya: @Marta (Payroll) tagging for context — this is cross-currency bonus handling question we get sometimes when payroll uses global supplemental tax rules vs local PAYE.
Marta (Payroll): Quick explainer: we normally gross in local currency and apply local tax rules. If payment flows through the global disbursement pipeline and currency conversion happens upstream, the system sometimes applied "supplemental" withholding using the US supplemental table by mistake. We'll need to check the payout route.
Marta (Payroll): Action: please submit a payroll case with the paystub + country of payment + bank FX stub (if you have it). We'll investigate and, if we mis-applied withholding, process a corrective adjustment and file remittance corrections with the local tax authority.
Alex C: case created #PR-2026-412 and uploaded bank FX confirmation. Thanks — any ETA?
Marta (Payroll): Thanks. I routed to the international team. Typical turnaround 7-14 business days for remittance corrections, but we can issue a gross-up/adjustment in the next payrun if needed.
Jamal: curious — will this affect my year-end tax reporting (like local tax forms or company-provided certificate)?
Marta (Payroll): If we perform a withholding correction, we'll issue an updated payslip and a corrected tax certificate for that tax year (if already issued, we may need a reissued one). We'll coordinate with you on next steps.
Priya: For people-ops docs — we should add a short KB on cross-currency bonus flows and what to attach to the case (payslip, bank FX proof, residency confirmation).@Marta can you own that?
Marta (Payroll): Yep I'll draft a KB and share for review.
PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2026-412 created and assigned to team:intl-payroll. Estimated SLA: 10 business days.
Alex C: appreciate it, keeping this open until resolved :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks everyone — cc payroll@redwood.com for tracking.
